scenario.name: show_bot_zoo
scenario.description: Live show: real people plus every kind of bot (about 4% of the crowd): speed bots, flooders, retry-spammers, address-hoppers, an identity farm, shortcut seekers and human mimics.

checks.name: entry list has unique receipt ids
merkle root recomputed from entry list == published root
root equals the root observed when the list was locked (before seed reveal)
tier gold: winner order + waitlist recomputed from scores
tier silver: winner order + waitlist recomputed from scores
tier general: winner order + waitlist recomputed from scores

counterfactual_definitions.fairdrop: one entry per verified identity; cryptographic draw; allocation ignores time, volume and IP
counterfactual_definitions.fcfs: earliest arrival wins; one seat per request; max_per_account seats per account
counterfactual_definitions.naive: every request is a lottery ticket (retries and floods multiply odds); same cap
